# Curated decoder regression inputs

[METAR/TAF parsing and verification](../../../../../src/layers/metar-taf/README.md#report-parsing)
owns the behavior tested here. Run from the repository root:

```sh
npm run test:weather:corpus
```

These fixtures also run in the domain workspace's normal tests, hence `npm test`
and `npm run verify`. They require no network, external decoder, credentials,
current date or browser.

## Provenance and expectations

`cases.json` pins the source revisions and identifies the source file, test or
table for each example. `origin` distinguishes:

- `report-body`: a historical pyIEM bulletin's station line through the end of
  its report. Transmission headers and separate `TAF`/`TAF AMD` lines are removed;
  internal spacing, line breaks, spelling and terminators remain unchanged.
- `upstream-test`: an exact raw string from another decoder's regression suite.
  Such strings may be incomplete or synthetic; they are not claimed to be full
  operational reports.
- `adapted-excerpt`: a documented fragment placed in a synthetic report. The
  `excerpt` and `note` identify what was borrowed and what the case proves. NASA's
  table dates/stations identify the fragment, not the synthetic wrapper.

Decoded METAR properties and TAF `fcsts` are **manually reviewed contract inputs**,
not AWC responses or results generated by ZLayer or another decoder. TAF dates are
fixed contexts, with expected cloud bases in feet and visibility in statute miles.
The cases independently specify period categories and dated FM annotations.
METAR raw-only cases deliberately omit decoded fields: no raw wind, temperature,
visibility or remarks decoder is implied. Supplementary visibility cases exercise
the string field at the adapter boundary, including malformed values and controls.

Unknown values use JSON `null` in expected results. A passing uncertainty case
means that raw text remains visible and unsupported data did not become an
invented measurement or a reassuring category. It does not mean every word has
been semantically decoded. In particular, snow negation and accumulation remarks
test retention and section isolation only; legacy hour-only TAF changes remain
unsupported. Upstream suggested repairs are not automatically adopted.

## Sources

- [NASA/TM-2014-218385](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20150000833/downloads/20150000833.pdf),
  October 2014, tables 13, 14, 16, 19 and 21. Historical deviations provide
  regression evidence, not new normative encoding rules. The
  [NTRS record](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20150000833) permits public use.
- [pyIEM TAF examples](https://github.com/akrherz/pyIEM/tree/6c5880e099350fcabcdc8f30653345f2b8b9d378/data/product_examples/TAF)
  and [tests](https://github.com/akrherz/pyIEM/blob/6c5880e099350fcabcdc8f30653345f2b8b9d378/tests/nws/products/test_taf.py):
  wrapping, probability groups, military formats, midnight/leap-year transitions,
  malformed FM times and legacy change periods.
- AVWX [METAR sanitization inputs](https://github.com/avwx-rest/avwx-engine/blob/4052569b7fe76cae50ce882a67504a3c51a059f2/tests/parsing/data/sanitize_metar_list_cases.json)
  and [TAF marker cases](https://github.com/avwx-rest/avwx-engine/blob/4052569b7fe76cae50ce882a67504a3c51a059f2/tests/current/data/sanitize_taf_line_cases.json).
- [python-metar tests](https://github.com/python-metar/python-metar/blob/281fb19e4f8870074844cba5e4b390a1f5fe7c6e/test/test_metar.py):
  reordered body fields, misplaced sea-level pressure, correction flags and a
  stray temperature token. Original notices are retained in [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).

## Extending the corpus

Add a case for a distinct observed format or failure, retain its exact evidence,
pin its source, and explain any adaptation. Review expected values and conservative
fallbacks before running the parser; never regenerate expectations from its output.
Pair a new recovery rule with an ambiguous or nearby invalid case that must remain
unresolved. Keep larger captured AWC response replays separate from these curated
cases so acquisition evidence and manually supplied adapter inputs remain clear.
